name: Flutter Developer
summary: Builds cross-platform mobile (and sometimes web) apps with Flutter/Dart, shipping to Play Store and App Store.
whatTheyDo: Implement UI and app logic, integrate APIs, manage state, handle offline/cache concerns, and maintain store releases.
responsibilities: Handle permissions and secure storage carefully
juniorExpectations: Implement screens and simple API calls
seniorExpectations: Lead store strategy and quality gates
careerTransitions: Can expand into fullstack mobile+backend or platform mobile roles
bangladeshNotes: Flutter hiring is active in Bangladesh product and agency contexts. Reviewed 2025–2026 postings and career ads commonly request Dart/Flutter, REST, state management (Bloc/Riverpod/Provider/GetX), Firebase, and Play/App Store publishing experience. Titles include Mobile App Developer (Flutter) and Full-stack Engineer (Flutter...). Experience asks vary from ~1 year to 5+ years depending on seniority.
experienceExpectations: Mid-level ads often cite ~2–3 years of production Flutter; senior/lead roles ask for more.
